svg.title: MetaHarmonizer system architecture and workflow
svg.desc: Clients enter through Caddy into FastAPI. Redis queues model work for an arq worker, PostgreSQL stores durable state, and host volumes hold study files and model assets. GitHub Actions validates releases while systemd performs knowledge-base rollout, monitoring, backup, alerts, and rollback.
svg.text: Client access, production runtime, durable state, integrations, delivery, and host operations
KB refresh sources, not runtime calls
CI - security - container smoke - real engine
quarterly KB rebuild, benchmark, and release
no direct application deployment from Actions
KB rollout - health checks - capacity reports - backup
Slack alerts - verified rollback - freshness monitoring
